title: Massa Mentality by Hugo
tagline: Politics, power and the road to Nigeria's 2027 election.
description: Massa is the boss who expects to be served. In the run-up to the 2027 general election, Stanley Ebosie (Hugo) asks who really holds power in Nigeria — and what it will take for citizens to use it.

title: The Diary Of A CEO
tagline: Long-form conversations with founders, experts and public figures about success, health and life.
description: Steven Bartlett sits down with entrepreneurs, scientists, athletes and thinkers for unhurried, candid interviews about what it takes to build a business and a life.
